comparison_to_think: The prior 9B Think requests on these same baseline and related-source prompts both hit the 8192-token output cap without a complete patch. Fast mode removed that diagnostic loop in this one direct screen, but only Fast plus related source produced a browser-passing stored-markup repair.
limitations: One request per condition is not a quality or latency distribution; Fast also changes sampling settings, so the observed difference cannot be attributed solely to disabling thinking.

The captured browser report's source fingerprint was stale relative to the prompted app.js. Chrome replay tested the proposed patch on that prompted source in a disposable fixture, not on a native agent's current workspace.
These were direct requests without OpenCode tools, compaction, restart or autonomous coding. The full strict UI gate and 45-60-minute green endurance still fail or remain unqualified.
decision: Do not change the default mode or claim a full task pass from this direct screen. Test bounded current dependency retrieval and Fast mode in a fresh native OpenCode coding workflow with current-source browser and independent review checks. Keep the guarded private 64K owner profile and public release pause.
